c.title: $4,399 / 3br - 1227ft2 - Yaletown 2 Bed 2 Bath + Solarium by Skytrain and David Lam Park (Yaletown)
c.description:
388 Drake Street, Vancouver BC
2 bedroom/2 bathroom/1 den
1,227 sq ft
1 EV Parking spot included

PANORAMIC WATERFRONT VIEWS at Governor's Tower! Experience unobstructed, breathtaking vistas of False Creek and David Lam Park through stunning floor-to-ceiling windows in this spacious 1,227 sqft 2 Bedroom + Solarium home. Thoughtfully designed with an open layout and abundant natural light, offering both comfort and functionality - every window provides direct water and park views. The Solarium can be used as a third bedroom or office space. Enjoy the tranquility of waterfront living right in the heart of vibrant Yaletown. Features include new flooring and appliances and generous in-suite storage. Steps from the seawall, skytrain station and with numerous dining and shopping options. One EV parking spot included with plenty of visitor parking.
Resort-style amenities include an indoor pool, fitness center, and 24-hour concierge.

WHEN RENTING:

Must pay a move-in/out fee as per strata bylaw
Deposits: half a month's security deposit
Lease term: minimum 1 year
Pets: No
Absolutely no smoking or vaping
A credit and reference check will be done for all applicants.
Renter's Insurance required

Please TEXT (no calls) Eric at show contact info or EMAIL to schedule a showing. Viewings available on weekends. Please message me to schedule a time.
